name: Batu's western campaign
summary: A Mongol army of perhaps 120,000 conquers the Volga Bulghars, the Cumans and the Rus principalities, sacks Kyiv, and drives into Poland and Hungary, destroying two European armies within days of each other in 1241. News of the Great Khan's death turns them back; the Golden Horde rules the Rus for two centuries.

stops.note: The Volga Bulghar capital is destroyed.
The first Rus city to fall.
The grand prince's capital is burned.
The mother of Rus cities is sacked.
Over the Carpathians, the main army destroys King Béla's Hungarians, two days after the western wing wins at Legnica.
The pursuit of Béla reaches the Adriatic.
News of Ögedei's death; Batu withdraws and founds his capital on the Volga.
